content: RAI repo top level: .github/, docker/, docs/, examples/, scripts/, src/, tests/. src/ holds the package monorepo: rai_core (agents, connectors, tools, HRI, frontend), rai_whoami, rai_asr, rai_tts, rai_sim, rai_bench, rai_perception, rai_nomad, rai_finetune, rai_interfaces (separate repo, pulled via vcs). No dedicated 'rai_bringup' launch package found in docs; demos (mobile robotics/Husarion ROSbot XL, manipulation/Franka Panda, agriculture) each ship their own launch/README under docs/demos/ or a sibling repo (e.g. RobotecAI/rai-rosbot-xl-demo). ROS2: Jazzy + Humble, Python 3.10/3.12, Ubuntu 22.04/24.04, Apache-2.0. Source: github.com/RobotecAI/rai README, docs/demos/manipulation.md.
